verdict.rationale: Visalaw AI's marketing shows example prompts that act on many items at once, such as extracting every name, date and passport number from multiple client PDFs into a spreadsheet and summarising a set of AAO decisions. It also claims to 'automate entire workflows'. These are only example prompts on a landing page, with no documented bulk or batch feature, and probes found no public API or OpenAPI spec for programmatic bulk actions. missing for 10: documented batch/bulk operation feature, limits or scale details, API or programmatic bulk access, hands-on or independent corroboration.
